articles.summary: Barchart: Netflix Stock Is Beaten Down - But Short Put Plays Are Attractive. Netflix stock has taken a beating, down 27.9% from a peak in late October 2025. Investors aren't too keen on its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. However, one way to play it is to short out-of-the-money (OTM) put options. Related tickers mentioned: NFLX.
